title: Machine Learning Foundations
summary: From programming and math to training your first neural network.

stages.title: Programming
stages.passCriteria: You can write, run and debug a small program on your own.

stages.title: Math
stages.passCriteria: You can explain vectors, matrices, derivatives and probability in your own words.

stages.title: Core Machine Learning
stages.passCriteria: You can train, evaluate and compare regression and classification models.

stages.title: Neural Networks
stages.passCriteria: You can implement backpropagation for a small network from scratch.
